To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the HTLV-1 long terminal repeat (LTR) is activated in Jurkat and in H9 T-cell lines by different mechanisms, mediated by PKCalpha/epsilon and PKCeta/delta, respectively.
the activation of HTLV- 1 LTR by TPA in Jurkat cells and H9 T-celis is mediated by two different mechanisms that involve PKCalpha and epsilon in Jurkat and PKCdelta and eta in H9, respectively.
PKC-Induce c-Jun in different Human T-cell lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
elucidation of the mechanisms that control HTLV-1 replication and the role of the HTLV-1 encoded Tax protein in this process.
the mechanisms by which HTLV-1 is able to activate its own transcription and to express its viral proteins in T-cells of HTLV- 1 carriers.
the elucidation of the molecular mechanisms of HTLV- 1 LTR activation in T-cells and their implication in ATL development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
in both cell types the activation of LTR by TPA was mediated by PKC-induced c-Jun, but in different ways.
PKC-induced elevation of non- phosphorylated c-Jun is required for TPA-induced HTLV-1 transcription in H9 T-cell lines but not in Jurkat cells.

in H9 cells the PKC-eta-mediated activation of the LTR is mediated by the binding of the c-Jun protein to the AP- 1 site, whereas, in Jurkat the PKCalpha and epsilon-mediated activation of the same LTR is mediated, in addition, by the binding of c-Jun to the Sp1-p-53 complex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LTR activation mechanisms are cell type-specific.
in Jurkat cells TPA activates HTVL-1 LTR by inducing the binding the non-phosphorylate c-Jun and p53 to the AP- 1 and Sp1-p53 complexes, respectively, to the LTR.

the HTLV-1 promoter is activated by different mechanisms that depend on the cell type, the PKC isoforms involved in this activation, the level of c-Jun phosphorylation, and its interaction with Sp1 and p53.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the activation mechanisms of HTLV- 1 LTR in different T-cell lines may be different.
PKC-induced c-Jun plays a dual role in HTLV- 1 LTR activation by TPA in T-cells.
HTLV-1 provirus is not only reactivated in different cell types by different mechanisms, but that it is also reactivated by different modes in the same cell type.
